## Purpose

PostgreSQL 18 with PostGIS backing the cache service.

## Dockerfile

`apps/postgres/Dockerfile` — `postgres:18` base with PostGIS installed.

## Docker Compose

Base config in `docker-compose.base.yml`: healthcheck (`pg_isready`), `shm_size: 128mb`. Test mode overrides to `restart: no`, `PGDATA: /tmp/postgres`, and mounts dev PG config + `pg_hba.conf`.

## Volumes

- Data: `${DATA_DIR}/cache/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data`
